title: Single extracted sound entry
description: Contract for one extracted sound: source tag provenance, characteristics nibbles, sync offset, and output digest for a verbatim MP3 payload slice.

character_id.description: DefineSound character ID, also the output file stem.

format.description: Sound format nibble; only 2 (MP3) is accepted.

rate.description: Sound rate nibble (0: 5.5 kHz, 1: 11 kHz, 2: 22 kHz, 3: 44 kHz).

sync_offset.description: Tag-payload offset of the first frame sync; must equal the expected uniform offset.

payload_bytes.description: Full tag payload length in bytes.

output.description: Converted output path relative to the repository root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the extracted MP3 bytes.
